title: Mangrove Loss Slowed 45%, But The Damage Remains
hook: Mangrove loss slowed 45%, after decades of destruction.
closing: Slower loss matters because every surviving mangrove still shields a coastline.
question: Can protection catch up?

segments.say: Mangrove area lost 3.6 million hectares. A natural barrier that shields coastlines shrank away.
Asia lost 1.9 million hectares of mangroves, the largest regional decline shown.
Annual mangrove loss slowed to 102 thousand hectares. Protection can reduce destruction before it stops.
